verdicts.reason: Both have the same faults. The body copy and the 'Shop Sale' CTA are shrunk to near-illegible sizes. 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped below the body copy, which breaks the original reading order. The 20% off headline is undersized for a story format. A adds a large dead gap between the bottle and the tiny CTA, plus an empty bottom quarter. B groups the bottle and CTA a little more tightly, but it still leaves dead space at the top and bottom, and its body copy runs into the edge of the circle.
